rows.label: Cicada
rows.hook: is known for its loud summer buzzing and for emerging in huge swarms after years underground

rows.label: Monarch butterfly
rows.description: milkweed butterfly in the family Nymphalidae
rows.hook: is an orange and black migrant that flies thousands of miles to overwinter in Mexico

rows.label: Mosquito
rows.hook: is a tiny biting pest whose females spread malaria and other diseases

rows.label: Dragonfly
rows.description: suborder of insects with long strong bodies and two pairs of wings
rows.hook: is a fast, agile hunter that zips over ponds on two pairs of shimmering wings

rows.label: Asian giant hornet
rows.hook: is the world's largest of its kind, nicknamed for a fearsome sting and a taste for honey bees

rows.label: Hornet
rows.hook: is a large, aggressive stinging wasp that builds papery nests

rows.label: Bumblebee
rows.hook: is a fuzzy, round pollinator that buzzes from flower to flower

rows.label: Fruit fly
rows.hook: is a tiny insect swarming over ripe bananas and a favorite subject of genetics labs

rows.label: Katydid
rows.description: family of insects in the order Orthoptera
rows.hook: is a green, leaf-mimicking relative of the grasshopper that sings at night

rows.label: Ladybug
rows.hook: is a red, black-spotted garden helper that eats aphids and is considered good luck

rows.label: German cockroach
rows.hook: is a common household pest that scurries away when the kitchen lights come on

rows.label: Firefly
rows.hook: is a beetle that lights up summer nights with a glowing abdomen

rows.label: Horse fly
rows.hook: is a large, hard-to-swat pest whose females deliver painful bites to livestock and people

rows.label: Luna moth
rows.hook: is a pale green giant with long tails on its wings that flies at night

rows.label: Silk moth
rows.hook: is a caterpillar farmed for the fine thread used to make a luxurious fabric

rows.label: Weevil
rows.hook: is a small beetle with a long snout that ruins crops like cotton

rows.label: Tsetse fly
rows.hook: is a biting African fly that spreads sleeping sickness

rows.label: American cockroach
rows.hook: is a large reddish-brown household pest, one of the biggest of its kind

rows.label: House fly
rows.description: species of insect in the class "Muscidae", sort of fly
rows.hook: is a common buzzing pest that lands on food and spreads germs

rows.label: Hercules beetle
rows.hook: is one of the largest and strongest of its kind, named for a mythical strongman and sporting a big horn

rows.label: Assassin bug
rows.hook: is a predator that stabs its prey with a sharp beak and injects digestive saliva

rows.label: Giant water bug
rows.hook: is a large aquatic predator that ambushes prey and can deliver a painful bite

rows.label: Honey bee
rows.hook: is a social pollinator that makes sweet golden food in a hive and does a waggle dance

rows.label: Praying mantis
rows.hook: is a green ambush predator that folds its front legs as if in prayer

rows.label: Scarab beetle
rows.hook: is a dung-rolling insect that ancient Egyptians held sacred

rows.label: Carpenter ant
rows.hook: is a large black insect that tunnels through wood to build its nest

rows.label: Mealworm
rows.hook: is a beetle larva sold as feed for pet reptiles and birds
